newsitem.title: USA: Cheesecake sees margins under pressure.
newsitem.headline: Cheesecake sees margins under pressure.

text.p: The Cheesecake Factory Inc said on Thursday that bakery margin comparisons will likely remain under pressure until early next year due to increases in fixed and semi-fixed costs associated with a new production facility and higher dairy-related ingredient costs.

"We have not experienced any further increases in our dairy-related ingredient costs for the last 30 days or so, and have actually seen our cost for butter begin to decrease," said David Overton, chief executive officer.
The company has also made price increases on several of bakery products to help offset the higher commodity costs, it said.
